```lean
import Mathlib

theorem putnam_2020_a2
  (k : ℕ) :
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j) = 4 ^ k := by
  -- We'll use induction on k
  have h_base : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 0, 2 ^ (0 - j) * Nat.choose (0 + j) j) = 4 ^ 0 := by
    simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h_ind : ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j) = 4 ^ n →
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) = 4 ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro n ih
    -- Split the sum at j = n+1 and use Pascal's identity
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 0 ≤ n + 1)]
    -- Handle the last term separately
    have h1 : 2 ^ (n + 1 - (n + 1)) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + (n + 1)) (n + 1) = Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by
      simp [Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_zero]
    rw [h1]
    -- Use the inductive hypothesis and manipulate the remaining sum
    have h2 : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) = 
              2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j) + 
              (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j + 1)) := by
      calc
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) = 
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 * 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1]
          ring_nf
        _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 * 2 ^ (n - j) * (Nat.choose (n + j) j + Nat.choose (n + j) (j + 1)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ]
          <;> simp [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
        _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 * 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j + 
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 * 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j + 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = 2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j) + 
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * 2 * Nat.choose (n + j) (j + 1) := by
          simp [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> simp_all [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = 2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j) + 
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j + 1)) * 2 := by
          simp [Finset.mul_sum]
          <;> ring_nf
    rw [h2]
    rw [ih]
    -- Simplify using known binomial identities
    have h3 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j + 1) = 
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (n - j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have h4 : j + 1 + (n - j) = n + 1 := by omega
      rw [← Nat.choose_symm_of_eq_add]
      <;> simp [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
      <;> omega
    rw [h3]
    -- Use the symmetry property of binomial coefficients
    have h5 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (n - j) = 
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [Nat.choose_symm_of_eq_add]
      <;> simp [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
      <;> omega
    rw [h5]
    -- Combine everything
    rw [ih]
    ring_nf
    <;> simp [pow_add, pow_mul, mul_assoc]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith
  
  -- Apply induction
  have h_main : ∀ k : ℕ, (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j) = 4 ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact h_base
    | succ n ih => exact h_ind n ih
  
  exact h_main k
```
